845,000 EUR taxpayer's money to subsidy the construction of Mosques in the German city of Monheim (Translation in the comments)

Controversial decision: The Islamic community in Monheim will receive a 845,000€ subsidy to build mosques. The mayor hopes they will shape the cityscape.

The city of Monheim supports the construction of mosques and community centers for Muslims with 845,000€. This has been decided on Wednesday evening by the city council with the votes of the communal party Peto. A decision that called the attention of many beyond Monheim. A hearing session was attended by about 900 people.

SPD, CDU, Greens and FDP voted against the proposal. However, Peto had the absolute majority with 65% of the votes. The joint petition for a referendum by the SPD and CDU was previously rejected.

The city mayor Daniel Zimmermann (Peto) wants to bring the Muslim communities to the foreground and better integrate them. The city will pay subsidies for about 845,000€ with which the communities will be able to acquire estate. This corresponds to about 15% of the required investment to build the Mosques, emphasized Zimmermann.

The mayor is enthusiastic

He has received about 300 emails from readers of extreme right-wing websites. However, during a hearing session 80% of the attendants were in favor of supporting the construction of the Mosques. "I hope the mosques will shape the cityscape and become historic monuments.

Monheim is the richest city in Nordrhein-Westphalia and can afford the subsidy. In Duisburg a similar initiative got a 40% subsidy.

The SPD criticized that the Turkish DITIB association was chosen as the partner for the project. The president of the CDU fraction, Markus Gronau, spoke about a "unique precedent". The president of Peto, Lisa Pientak, called the support of the CDU and SPD a lip service: "They say no to the estate, and no to the subsidies".

Minarets can be up to 25 meters tall

There are some conditions to the subsidy: The minarets aren't allowed to be taller than 25 meters. Furthermore, the communities are obligated to promote tolerance and conformity to the constitution. The construction of the mosque and community centers will be privately financed.

Why Pharah struggles in the competitive meta // Overwatch Discussion and Analysis

I see the argument, but I still think the meta for Overwatch is overblown and exaggerated. Pharah, like any other character, is effective in the right situations and when played by a skilled player. When there are counters for her perhaps they are extra effective given her weaknesses, but when she is used strategically she is super effective and offers consistent and chaos-inducing damage from the sky, not to mention the easy environmental kills.

Every time I see that the meta has changed I also see that the heros that are being excluded (for instance, people still freak out if you play Junkrat or Hanzo) are extremely effective in the right situations, used as the right counter, when played by a skilled player. This leads me to the conclusion, what good is the meta? Its nonsense.

Having some characters geared towards a more specialized team build should not exclude them from the meta just as not every 2-2-2 team build is the best choice in every situation.

I understand that the meta takes this stuff into account, but I think its ridiculous to say pharah isn't effective in the meta right now.

I play low gold and could get high gold with one friend who is from CS:GO. and our most successful team has been. Zarya,winston,mercy,widow,pharah,bastion. This literal goes against like 90% of the meta, but our CS:GO friend is an awsome widow who keeps most the trouble off of me as bastion and the winston take care of the genji. While I am free to mow does most the team. Sure I get all the trash damage but it works.
